title: Smart File Recovery
summary: Recover deleted photos, videos, files & audio from your Android device.
description:
Smart File Recovery – Restore Lost Files in Seconds!
Losing important photos, videos, documents, or audio files is stressful — but now you can recover them quickly and safely with Smart File Recovery, the powerful yet simple file recovery tool for Android.
Whether you accidentally deleted a memory, lost files after a factory reset, or need to retrieve media from an SD card, Smart File Recovery helps you get back what matters most — all without uploading your data to the cloud.
🔹 Photo Recovery – Retrieve deleted pictures, selfies, and albums
🔹 Video Recovery – Restore lost video clips and recordings
🔹 File Recovery – Get back documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, and more
🔹 Audio Recovery – Reclaim music, voice notes, and audio files
✅ All recovery happens locally on your device – no internet needed
✅ No personal data uploaded – your files stay private and secure
✅ One-click scan – fast and easy to use
✅ Works offline – recover files anytime, anywhere
Smart File Recovery scans your internal storage and SD card to find deleted files that are still recoverable. The app does not modify your system or access your cloud accounts — it’s built for privacy and performance.
Note: Recovery success depends on how recently files were deleted and whether new data has overwritten them. We recommend stopping usage of the device immediately after deletion for best results.
Download Smart File Recovery today and bring back your precious memories and important files — safely and securely.
